One earlier Edge first navigation took 16.040 seconds; the followup was 2.781, 1.191, 1.242 seconds. The transient initial latency has no conclusively established cause.
Completed data batches survive interruption. Counters are filesystem checkpoints and should not be treated as a transactionally exact audit after a crash.
The existing full backup covers the initially expired copies. VERIFYONLY with checksums is not an actual restore test.
